reference: Mi-24V: pilot steam panel with the SPO-10/SPO-15 RWR head, centre cyclic, collective and two engine levers on the left, ASP-17V automatic sight on the coaming; operator: basic flight instruments around the KPS-53AV gun sight / Raduga-Sh missile sight with its two-grip handle unit, emergency cyclic, collective and pedals. Sources: 16va.be 'Combat Hinds' (https://www.16va.be/4.2_les_mi-24_part1_eng.html), airvectors.net Mi-24 history (https://airvectors.net/avhind_1.html: fold-away operator flight controls on the Mi-24V), Chuck's DCS Mi-24P guide cockpit figures (https://chucksguides.com/aircraft/dcs/mi-24p/) for the turquoise tandem cockpit layout
